_rubric: (informational, ignored by scorer) Per-candidate promo-quality judgement from a producer's POV: strong = would hold attention under paid vertical ad placement; usable = would hold some viewers; weak = unlikely to work as an ad; unusable = wrong content for acquisition. Labels are used ONLY for post-hoc precision measurement vs the judge ranking. No prompt or ranking configuration was tuned against these labels.
_reviewer: GLM Stage 4 independent sample, 2026-11-08, after reading each full candidate.
_strata: head (top-10 featured) + ranks 11-20 (reserve + next featured) + rejected high-embeds; not a random corpus sample.
